facts.text: I enjoy the modern sound of military bands with electronic instruments.
I think the use of technology in military bands can help make them more accessible to younger generations.
I think social media has played a big role in promoting military bands and creating a sense of community around them.
I think technology and social media have transformed military bands into more than just musical performers.
I am glad to see the military embracing change and staying relevant in a fast-paced digital world.
I think the military is using technology to connect with people outside the military community too.
I think using technology helps showcase the talents of military musicians.
I think using technology helps bring people together around something positive.

connecting with people outside the military community
